## About
Steve Luzzi grew up at his father's full service station, spending his summers waiting on cars at the pump islands and learning how to fix them. He took over his own station as a young man, then came to Downey, bought Pardella's Auto Center and later renamed it Steven Luzzi Automotive.
Cars keep changing, so we keep up. That means up to date repair and test equipment, experienced technicians, and a shop that stays organized, clean and safe. Every customer gets a full report of the repairs and services needed, and we keep records of all the work we do.
Our neighbors tell us what matters to them: honest advice, work done right, and a car that's ready quickly. Some families have trusted us with their cars for many years, and we hope to keep serving Downey for a long time.

## Services
- Check engine light: We track down why the light is on and explain what it will take to fix it.
- Hybrid service: Belts, hoses, fluid exchanges, brakes, lights and air conditioning on Ford, Honda and Toyota hybrids.
- Fuel pump replacement: Diagnosis and replacement when your fuel pump is failing.
- Tires and high speed balancing: New tires and balancing for a smooth ride on the freeway.
- Rear end differential repair: Repair work on rear differentials for cars and light trucks.
- Charging and starting systems: Batteries, starters and alternators checked and replaced.

## FAQ
Q: What makes do you work on?
A: Cars and light trucks from many makers, including Chevrolet, Ford, Toyota, Lexus, Nissan, Mercedes, Volvo, and some BMW and VW models.

Q: How do I schedule a repair?
A: Give us a call at 562-869-7778 and we'll set up a time.
